resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register's build field gives 1940 while its description says built around the late 1930s or early 1940s. The story reports both and does not pick one as settled.

notes_for_editor: Register is the main source; the CWPP only places the Commission's Screven County unit on Buttermilk Road and does not mention the tower, so it is not shown to be the same site as the tower. Register elevation 218 ft matches tnlandforms. WebSearch returned nothing specific to a Screven County tower. Access level and staffing as-of date unknown and left out. The build year is the main open question (1940 in the build field, late 1930s or early 1940s in the description); a Georgia Forestry Commission history or 1930s-40s county newspapers might settle it.
